name: Comoros (1996–2001)
description: A green field with a white crescent opening towards the fly enclosing a column of four white five-pointed stars, with the white Arabic inscription 'Allah' in the upper fly and 'Muhammad' in the lower hoist.
history: Flag introduced with the constitution of 6 October 1996, which turned the crescent to face the fly and added the names of God and the Prophet in the corners. The 2001 referendum that created the Union of the Comoros replaced it with the present four-striped flag on 23 December 2001.
